# Strategic Marketer

> Strategic Marketer helps established businesses identify, install and activate practical AI systems built around their brand, their knowledge, their customers and their growth priorities, not around the latest tool.

Strategic Marketer installs AI systems for established businesses: a Business Intelligence Agent that captures the company's brand voice, offers, customers and positioning, then powers content creation, follow-up, automation and internal knowledge. The engagement starts with an AI Business Assessment, a consultative conversation that produces a clear diagnosis and a prioritized roadmap.

## Pages

- [Home](https://strategic-marketer.vercel.app/): What Strategic Marketer does, the Business Intelligence Agent methodology, the AI Business Assessment, client results and industries served.
- [For Agencies](https://strategic-marketer.vercel.app/for-agencies): Licensing program for agencies that want to deliver proven AI-powered solutions to their clients under their own brand without building the technology themselves.
